description: Navigate the topic taxonomy. Without `parent_slug`, returns the top-level roots (Politics, Business, Technology, etc.). With `parent_slug` set, returns the direct children of that topic. Topic slugs use a `parent/child` convention (e.g. `politics/elections`) and let agents browse the hierarchy to find well-named categories.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

parent_slug.description: Topic slug or ID. Returns the direct children of this topic. Omit for top-level roots (Politics, Business, Technology, etc.).

name: particle_topic_browse
